verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party event-triggered rules, such as running an agent when a file changes, a PR opens or a webhook arrives. Cron scheduling is a time-based recurring trigger, not an event rule. Auto Approve controls permissions, not triggers, and running headless in GitHub Actions or GitLab relies on the host pipeline's own event triggers. These are adjacent features or host-platform capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
